info.title: Blüdhaven Pets Platform API
info.summary: Intake, adoption, veterinary, and retail operations for Blüdhaven Pets.
info.description:
The Blüdhaven Pets platform runs municipal animal intake, statutory microchip
registration, veterinary clearance, and 30-minute adoption holds. Three
branches and an online catalog carry the retail and adoption inventory.

### Authentication

Send an OAuth 2.0 bearer token in the `Authorization` header, or an API key
in `X-API-Key`. The sandbox gateway runs the authorization server, so the
reference completes a real sign-in rather than asking for a pasted string.

- **Authorization code with PKCE** backs the Connect button. Approve the
  consent screen, and the client exchanges the code for a token that lasts
  one hour. The refresh token lasts thirty days.
- **Client credentials** mints a token in one POST for a script with no
  browser. Send `client_id=bludhaven-staff-portal` and the scopes you need.
  Omit `scope` to receive the four read scopes.
- **API key** authenticates server-to-server jobs and POS register terminals.
  Send it in the `X-API-Key` header. A key carries an assigned scope set
  rather than the whole catalog, so a register key reaches retail stock and
  nothing else. An unrecognized key returns `401`, and a key outside the set
  a route requires returns `403`.

The gateway verifies both credentials. It signs every token with HMAC-SHA256
and looks every key up in its registry, so a made-up value of either kind
fails. An `Authorization` header and an `X-API-Key` header may both arrive.
The request passes when either one satisfies the route. A session token from
`POST /sessions` behaves like an access token, with the two applicant scopes
and nothing more.

### Scopes

Every bearer token carries scopes, and each OAuth route requires one of them.

- `read:animals` reads animal records, intake history, and eligibility.
- `write:animals` creates, amends, and withdraws animal records.
- `read:adoptions` reads holds and adoption applications.
- `write:adoptions` places holds, releases holds, and submits applications.
- `read:applicants` reads applicant accounts during counselor review.
- `write:applicants` creates and amends applicant accounts.
- `vet:clearance` files veterinary certificates. Licensed practitioners only.
- `read:retail` reads inventory levels and supply orders.
- `write:retail` places and cancels supply orders.
- `admin:adoptions` overrides hold conflicts and issues refunds on any cost
  line.

### Regulatory obligations

Every intake record carries a 15-digit ISO 11784/11785 microchip number.
Municipal code forbids releasing an intact animal without verified spay or
neuter certification, so the platform blocks adoption until a veterinarian
files clearance.

### Support

Request credentials or report a production incident through
**budbaker@bludhavenpets.com**. Include the `X-Request-Id` value from the
failing response.

get.description:
Returns intake records that match every supplied filter. The public
adoption gallery sends `status=AVAILABLE`, and the veterinary worklist
sends `status=MEDICAL_QUARANTINE`. Results paginate with `cursor`.

This route carries no security requirement, because the adoption catalog
is public. A prospective adopter can browse without an account.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Adoption status to match. Omit the parameter to list every status.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Branch location that holds the animal.

parameters.name: temperament_tag
parameters.description:
Volunteer-entered tag, such as `good-with-cats` or
`apartment-friendly`. Use it to build the matching view that
adoption counselors rely on.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20 and caps at 100.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. `null` on the last page.

post.description:
Creates an intake record at a branch facility. The request must carry a
15-digit ISO 11784 microchip number and an intake branch. A microchip
already on file returns `409`, because the platform cannot hold two
records for one animal.

409.description: The microchip number already belongs to another record.

example.title: Microchip Already Registered
example.detail: Microchip 985141002348123 belongs to pet_krypto_210 at loc_harbor_04.

get.description:
Returns one intake record with its health clearance, adoption fee, and
current status. A record withdrawn after transfer returns `410`, because
municipal law keeps the microchip history.

This route carries no security requirement, because the adoption catalog
is public.

410.description: The record moved to a partner shelter and no longer serves requests.

put.description:
Replaces the staff-editable fields when a counselor corrects a breed,
weight, or name. The platform keeps the prior values in the audit trail
and re-runs the eligibility check before it returns the record.

410.description: The record moved to a partner shelter and no longer accepts amendments.

delete.description:
Retires a record after a transfer to a partner shelter. Withdrawal keeps
the microchip registration, and a record under an active hold returns
`409` until the hold expires or a counselor releases it.

409.description: An active adoption hold blocks withdrawal.

post.summary: Request a presigned photo upload URL
post.description:
Generates a direct-to-storage presigned PUT URL. The client uploads raw
binary (JPEG or PNG up to 8 MB) straight to the object storage bucket
without routing bytes through the application servers.

caption.example: Krypto at the Harbor branch play yard.

get.description:
Returns the rabies certificate, spay or neuter certification, and
quarantine release for one animal. Adoption eligibility depends on this
record, so a stale `rabies_expiration_date` blocks placement.

post.description:
Attaches a veterinarian's clearance to the record and moves the animal
from `VET_CLEARANCE` to `AVAILABLE` when every requirement passes. The
call requires the license number of the signing practitioner.

Locks one eligible animal to one applicant for 30 minutes. The lock spans
every branch and the public website, so a second attempt on the same
animal returns `409` while the hold lives. A counselor can release the
hold early with `DELETE /adoptions/holds/{holdId}`.

branch_id.description: Branch where the applicant will meet the animal.

notes.example: In-person interview scheduled at the Harbor branch.

404.description: The animal or the applicant does not exist.

409.description: Another applicant already holds the animal.

example.title: Adoption Hold Conflict
example.detail: Animal pet_krypto_210 is currently reserved under active hold hld_77a28f expiring at 2026-11-17T08:15:00Z.

422.description: The animal is not eligible, such as under medical quarantine.

get.description:
Returns the hold with the seconds remaining on the lock. Poll it at most
once a minute, because the countdown lives on `expires_at`.

delete.description:
Frees the animal for other applicants before the 30-minute window closes.
A counselor releases a hold when the interview fails or the applicant
leaves the branch.

409.description: The hold already converted into an application.

post.description:
Converts an active hold into an application and starts the counselor
review. Submission freezes the $150 placement fee and the $25 municipal
license fee on the application record.

get.description:
Returns on-hand and reserved counts for every retail SKU at one branch.
The POS reconciles its local ledger against this snapshot each night, and
a mismatch raises a ticket for the store manager.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Branch to report. Omit the parameter to read the Harbor branch.

post.description:
Orders supplies, such as food, litter, or leashes, for one branch. Animals
never move through this route, because adoption runs through the hold
workflow instead.

404.description: The supplier catalog has no item for that SKU, or the branch does not exist.

get.description: Returns one supply order with its fulfillment stage and the branch that placed it.

delete.description:
Cancels an order before the picking stage. A shipped order returns `409`,
because the supplier already left the distribution center.

409.description: The order already shipped, so the supplier cannot recall it.

post.description:
Registers an applicant before the interview. The platform verifies the
email and leaves the account in `pending` until a counselor confirms
identity in person.

409.description: The email already belongs to an account.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Account handle the applicant chose at registration.

get.description:
Returns one account with its verification state and preferred species.
Counselors read this record during the adoption interview.

put.description:
Replaces the details an applicant controls, such as phone number and
preferred species. Verification state stays staff-controlled, so a client
cannot promote itself.

delete.description:
Closes an account at the applicant's request and anonymizes the contact
details. Adoption records keep the account identifier for the statutory
retention period.

409.description: An open hold or application blocks closure.

post.description:
Exchanges email and password for a short-lived bearer token. The portal
keeps the token in memory and never writes it to storage.

401.description: Email and password do not match an account.

delete.description: Revokes the bearer token that authorized the call.

204.description: Session closed. The token no longer works.

post.summary: Return a placement fee or supplies line on an application
post.description:
Returns money against an adoption application. Each cost line follows its
own rule, so one request can return the placement fee while it withholds
the deposit and the municipal license fee.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key. A retry with the same key returns the original refund.

201.description: Refund recorded. Settlement follows the processor schedule.

200.description: The idempotency key already produced this refund, so no second refund was issued.

409.description: The application already carries a refund for that line.

example.title: Duplicate Refund
example.detail: Refund rfd_01HQ9B7TX4 already covers the placement fee on app_2026_1188.

post.description:
Signs an example payload and returns the delivery the platform would
send, including the `X-Bludhaven-Signature` header. Replay the returned
body against a local receiver to prove that verification works before a
live event depends on it.

The gateway does not dial a subscriber URL. It returns the delivery for
you to replay, which keeps signature testing off the public internet.

schema.description: Event to sign. Omit the body to sign the hold-expired example.

200.description: A signed delivery, ready to replay against a receiver.

post.description:
The platform sends this event when a 30-minute reservation hold expires
with no application. The hold releases and the animal returns to
AVAILABLE.

The platform sends this event when a municipal veterinarian certifies
rabies observation or spay/neuter clearance. The certification updates
the animal's adoption eligibility.

bludhaven_oauth.description:
OAuth 2.0 token issued by the sandbox authorization server. The
authorization code flow with PKCE backs the Connect button in this
reference. The client credentials grant mints a token for a script.
A token past its `exp` returns `401`, and a token without a scope the
route requires returns `403`.

api_key.name: X-API-Key
api_key.description:
Key for server-to-server inventory synchronization and POS register
terminals. A key carries an assigned scope set rather than the full
catalog. A register key reaches retail stock, and a server job key
reaches intake and holds. A route outside that set returns `403`, and an
unrecognized key returns `401`.

The sandbox publishes two working keys, because a test credential is
safe to copy:

- `bpk_sandbox_pos_7f3a91c4` reaches `read:retail` and `write:retail`.
- `bpk_sandbox_ops_2d8be05f` reaches `read:animals`, `write:animals`,
  `write:adoptions`, and `read:retail`.

Production issues a per-integration key through
**budbaker@bludhavenpets.com**. Rotate a key by requesting its
replacement, then removing the old value.

Unauthorized.description:
The gateway could not identify the caller. The cause is a missing header,
a token without a valid signature, an expired token, a retired session,
or a key outside the registry. The `WWW-Authenticate` challenge names
which scheme failed, `Bearer` for a token and `ApiKey` for a key.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Challenge that names the scheme the client must present.

example.title: Unauthorized
example.detail: The request carried no bearer token. Sign in through the staff portal or attach an API key.

Forbidden.description: The token authenticated, but it lacks a scope this route requires.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Challenge that names the scope the route requires.

example.title: Insufficient Scope
example.detail: The access token lacks write:animals. Request that scope during authorization, then retry.

InvalidRequest.description: A parameter or body field failed validation.

example.title: Invalid Request
example.detail: A required field is missing, or a value falls outside its accepted range.

Unprocessable.description: The request parsed, but a business rule rejected it.

example.title: Business Rule Rejected
example.detail: The request broke a policy rule, such as an ineligible animal or a SKU with no stock.

NotFound.description: The platform holds no record for that identifier.

example.title: Record Not Found
example.detail: No record matches the identifier in the request.

RateLimited.description: The caller exceeded the per-key rate limit. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next attempt.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

example.title: Rate Limited
example.detail: The credential exceeded its window. Retry in 12 seconds.

BranchId.description:
Identifier of a physical facility. `loc_harbor_04` runs intake and
surgery, `loc_downtown_01` runs the adoption floor and supplies counter,
and `loc_westend_08` runs transitional care and partner rescue intake.

Branch.description:
Physical facility that holds animals, staff, and retail stock. Every
intake record, adoption hold, and supply order names one.

kind.description:
Role in the network. `intake` handles surrender, stray rescue,
quarantine, and surgery. `retail` runs the adoption floor and the
supplies counter. `transitional` holds long-term care for partner
rescues.

phone.description: Front desk number for client visits.

services.description: Services a client can book at this facility.

AnimalStatus.description:
Lifecycle state, in order. `INTAKE` admits an animal through surrender or
stray rescue, and the catalog stays hidden. `VET_CLEARANCE` covers the
clinical intake exam and statutory microchipping. `MEDICAL_QUARANTINE`
isolates an animal for infection or bite observation, which hides the
record from clients and blocks holds. `AVAILABLE` opens the animal to the
adoption catalog. `RESERVED_HOLD` marks an exclusive 30-minute lock.
`ADOPTED` closes the record after the platform collects the license fee
and transfers the microchip registry.

rabies_tag_number.description: Municipal rabies tag issued for the vaccination.

spay_neuter_certified.description: Municipal code blocks placement of an intact animal.

veterinarian_license.description: License number of the signing practitioner.

adoption_fee_cents.description: Placement fee in cents. The Harbor branch charges $150.00 for a dog.

branch_id.description: Branch where the counselor reviews the application.

counselor_id.description: Counselor assigned to the review. `null` until the queue assigns one.

license_fee_cents.description: Municipal registration fee, collected with the placement fee.

reservation_deposit_cents.description: Non-refundable deposit that converts a hold into a scheduled pickup.

supplies_subtotal_cents.description: Unopened retail supplies on the same checkout. Refundable until pickup.

placed_at.description: Timestamp the counselor closed the placement. `null` until approval.

password.description: Write-only. The platform stores an Argon2id hash and never returns the value.

account_status.description:
Verification state. A counselor moves an account from `pending` to
`verified` at the interview.

token.description:
Opaque signed token. The gateway mints a fresh one on every call, so
copy it from the response rather than from this example. It reaches
the routes an applicant session reads, and nowhere else.

status.description: Fulfillment stage for the supply order.

Inventory.description: On-hand stock per SKU for one branch, plus the quantity reserved by open orders.

upload_url.description: Presigned HTTPS PUT destination on Cloudflare R2 / S3 storage.

public_url.description: Public CDN URL where the image will be readable after upload.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem detail. Every error response uses this shape.

type.description: Stable error identifier that clients can branch on.

detail.example: Animal pet_krypto_210 is currently reserved under active hold hld_77a28f expiring at 2026-11-17T08:15:00Z.

instance.description: Request path that produced the error.

request_id.description: Value of the `X-Request-Id` header, for support tickets.

amount_cents.description: Amount to return. Must not exceed the refundable balance on the application.

refund_retail_supplies.description: Return the unopened supplies line with the placement fee.

veterinary_record_id.description: Required when `reason` is `MEDICAL_DISQUALIFICATION`. Must resolve to a cleared certificate.

withheld.description: Amount the platform keeps, per cost line.

settles_at.description: Processor estimate. Read `status` rather than counting elapsed time.

AdoptionHoldExpiredEvent.description: Envelope delivered when a reservation hold lapses.

VeterinaryClearanceFiledEvent.description: Envelope delivered when a municipal veterinarian files clearance.

WebhookDispatchReceipt.description: A signed delivery returned for replay, not a queued outbound call.
